name: detect_header_row
description: Detect which row contains column headers in Excel data for RFQ processing

header_row_index.description: 0-based index of the row containing headers (0 = first row, 1 = second row, etc.). Return -1 if no clear header row exists.

confidence.description: Confidence percentage (0-100) in the header row detection

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why this row was chosen as the header row

detected_columns.description: List of column headers found in the detected header row
